description: pixel art landscape, the edge of a primeval forest at dusk seen from a small clearing: tall dark spruces and old twisted oaks, a narrow path leading between them into the deep forest, thin ice-blue glowing runes and faint luminous blue lines in the grass at the forest's edge, soft mist low over the ground, a pale moon behind thin clouds, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted dark palette of deep greens and navy with ice-blue accents, no text, no border, no people, no animals
